snp5.10:1.1: “He who has no in-dwelling sense desires,
snp5.10:1.3: he in whom no craving is found,
snp5.10:1.5: what kind of freedom is there for him?”
snp5.10:2.1: “He who has no in-dwelling sense desires,
snp5.10:2.3: he in whom no craving is found,
snp5.10:2.4: he who has crossed beyond doubts,
snp5.10:2.5: there is no further freedom for him.”
snp5.10:3.1: “Is he without yearning, or is he still yearning? said venerable Todeyya,
snp5.10:3.2: Is he wise, or is he still acquiring wisdom?
snp5.10:3.3: I would know just what the sage is like, Sakyan:
snp5.10:3.4: Explain that to me, All-Seeing Visionary.”
snp5.10:4.1: “He is without yearning, he is not still yearning.
snp5.10:4.2: He is wise, he is not still acquiring wisdom.
snp5.10:4.3: Know that the Sage is just like this, Todeyya:
snp5.10:4.4: he has nothing, and is not clinging to sense existence.”
